Authors: 1maginer0, senxyzplayeE If a point $P$ in Minecraft has coordinates $x, y, z$ with facing angles $ry, rx$, and needs to be represented in a mathematical 3D coordinate system, the transformation is $x, y, z \to z, x, y$ and $ry, rx \to -ry, -rx$.
